verdict.rationale: n8n's core product is a visual canvas for building multi-step automations, extensively documented (n8n-docs-1/2/13) and corroborated by hands-on users describing building workflows, debugging via execution history, and even non-programmers building complex backends (n8n-comm-8, n8n-comm-18). Some community reports note that complex data transformations still benefit from coding knowledge (n8n-comm-3, n8n-comm-13), which tempers a pure no-code claim. Missing for 10: independent benchmark of pure no-code success rate on complex workflows, and clearer resolution of the 'no-code vs low-code' framing.
